verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no rule or trigger system that automatically runs actions when events occur, in either the Editor or the platform. Engine scripts that 'handle user input' and 'manage game logic' are developer building blocks for coding behavior, not a rules feature. The Editor API and MCP server provide programmatic or agent-driven control, not event-triggered automation rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
